headline: RBC Capital Maintains Sector Perform on Extra Space Storage, Raises Price Target to $157
summary: RBC Capital  analyst Brad Heffern   maintains Extra Space Storage (NYSE:EXR) with a Sector Perform and raises the price target from $153 to $157.
